label: Вагон
description: A 10-sentence usage card for вагон (train car).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Вагон' is the nominative subject, described by 'пустой'. 'Этот' is the agreeing masculine demonstrative, and 'совсем' intensifies. A clean model for a masculine noun.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Вагон' is the accusative direct object of 'нашёл'. As an inanimate masculine noun, its accusative equals the nominative. 'Свой' shows it is the speaker's own.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Вагона' is the genitive required after 'около' to express proximity. 'Проводник' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'. A practical station scene.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Вагону' is the dative form after 'к' to express movement toward. 'Нашему' agrees in the masculine dative. The dative is the natural case after 'к'.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Вагоном' is the instrumental after 'с' to express together with. 'Новым' agrees in the masculine instrumental, and 'поезд' is the nominative subject. A natural comitative pattern.

Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В вагоне' uses the prepositional form 'вагоне' after 'в' to mark where. 'Много людей' uses the genitive plural after the quantity word. A common travel observation.
Strategic focus: Genitive of origin. 'Вагона' is the genitive after 'из' to express exiting from. 'Пассажиры' is the nominative plural subject of 'выходят'. A core motion-out-of pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a numeral. 'Вагонов' takes the genitive plural after 'десять'. 'В поезде' marks the location. A core counting pattern for transport.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Вагоны' is the nominative plural subject, described by 'удобные'. 'Новые' is the agreeing plural adjective. A clean plural description pattern.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В вагон' uses the accusative 'вагон' after 'в' to express getting into. 'Первый' agrees in the masculine accusative. A core boarding pattern.
